name: typephp
one_liner: Compiles ordinary PHP code into a fast, standalone native program, so a PHP app can run without needing PHP installed.
buyer: A PHP shop that wants to ship a fast, protected native binary — not a typical outside buyer.
business_use_cases: A PHP agency ships a client's internal tool as a single native binary instead of requiring a PHP runtime install.
A software vendor protects their PHP source code by shipping compiled binaries instead of raw source.
A hosting company offers 'compiled PHP' as a performance upgrade tier for CPU-heavy scripts.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid migration/compilation service helping PHP shops package their apps as native binaries.

steal_this: Purely a developer-infra tool — no direct weekend consumer product here.
